title: Acetylation-Dependent Histone H2AX Exchange Suppresses Pathological Senescence via MDC1 Degradation.
authors: Ikura, Masae; Furuya, Kanji; Horikoshi, Yasunori; Tashiro, Satoshi; Shiraki, Takuma; Ikura, Tsuyoshi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究组蛋白H2AX乙酰化交换调控衰老，核心是组蛋白修饰与DNA损伤应答，未涉及蛋白质-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cellular senescence has a dual role in both tumor suppression and the promotion of age-related diseases. This paradox suggests the existence of functionally distinct "beneficial" and "detrimental" senescent states, yet the molecular basis that governs their fate has remained elusive. Here, we reveal that the dynamic exchange of histone H2AX on chromatin functions as an essential quality control mechanism that dictates the quality of senescence. We demonstrate that the histone acetyltransferase TIP60, in complex with the chaperone FACT, acetylates H2AX at lysine 5 (K5), which in turn drives its dynamic exchange. This histone exchange is indispensable for promoting the degradation of the DNA damage response mediator MDC1, a process we uncover is mediated by a novel DNA-PKcs-p97 signaling axis. Disruption of this TIP60-FACT-H2AX exchange pathway leads to the hyperaccumulation of MDC1 and a shift toward error-prone nonhomologous end joining (NHEJ), inducing a pathological senescent state with oncogenic potential. Our study redefines histone exchange from a passive chromatin event to an active regulatory hub that determines the fate of aging cells. These findings provide a molecular basis for the heterogeneity of senescence and establish a rationale for developing "senomorphic" therapies aimed at improving the quality of aging.
abstract_zh: 细胞衰老在肿瘤抑制和促进年龄相关疾病中具有双重作用。这一悖论提示存在功能上不同的“有益”和“有害”衰老状态，然而调控其命运的分子基础至今仍不明确。在此，我们揭示染色质上组蛋白H2AX的动态交换作为一种必要的质量控制机制，决定衰老的质量。我们证明组蛋白乙酰转移酶TIP60与分子伴侣FACT形成复合物，在赖氨酸5（K5）位点乙酰化H2AX，进而驱动其动态交换。这种组蛋白交换对于促进DNA损伤应答介质MDC1的降解不可或缺，我们揭示该过程由一种新的DNA-PKcs-p97信号轴介导。破坏这一TIP60-FACT-H2AX交换通路会导致MDC1过度积累，并转向易错的非同源末端连接（NHEJ），从而诱导具有致癌潜力的病理性衰老状态。我们的研究将组蛋白交换从被动的染色质事件重新定义为决定衰老细胞命运的主动调控枢纽。这些发现为衰老的异质性提供了分子基础，并为开发旨在改善衰老质量的“衰老形态”疗法确立了理论依据。
